changes: Verified the two Codex-reported review-run metadataRoot defect classes and completed the fix: captureReviewRunSnapshot and diagnoseReviewRunSnapshot now carry metadataRoot correctly, and both consumer freshness checks stay fresh for wrapper-root custom storyDir metadata-only commits. Added durable red/green smoke coverage for wrapper-root custom storyDir, legacy no-workspaceBinding fallback, default projectRoot/plain-repo byte identity, assertCurrentReviewRunForEvidence, and validateEvidenceRunBinding through collectReviewerEvidenceState.
usage: Use review_run_start, review_pass_set, reviewer evidence checks, and review escalation gates normally. In wrapper-root projects with a custom storyDir, metadata-only commits under that storyDir no longer false-stale reviewer runs because freshness recompute uses the signed workspaceBinding metadataRoot. Plain-repo/default-storyDir and legacy no-workspaceBinding behavior remain unchanged.
expectedOutcome: In a wrapper-root project with custom storyDir, a metadata-only commit to the storyDir should not false-stale reviewer runs; review-run material/story hash semantics should match DONE freshness semantics; plain-repo/default-storyDir behavior should remain byte-identical; lattice validate should be all green.
actualTranscript: Final verification passed: npm --prefix packages/main run build; npm --prefix packages/main run test:review-run-metadataroot-wrapper-root; lattice validate --story=B-9dcb --json with 31 configured commands; lattice done_required_validate with packages/main build and root npm test. Review lanes concept, quality, and test-coverage all passed after F-003; 3 rounds x 2 hosts were submitted with claude-cli and codex-cli only. F-003 was caught before DONE and fixed by adding collectReviewerEvidenceState coverage that reaches validateEvidenceRunBinding.
outcomeDiff: Expected and actual match the original intent. The only mid-flight difference was a review-discovered coverage gap: validateEvidenceRunBinding was initially not exercised by the smoke; the gap was fixed and re-reviewed before DONE.
limitations: Scope warnings remain advisory for ProofStory metadata artifacts generated by the lifecycle. No Authority Server production claim is made. agy-cli was not used for the final 3x2 because codex-cli and claude-cli were available.
pitfalls: Do not reuse stale reviewer passes after storyFilesHash changes. If review evidence goes stale, return to REVIEW and regenerate explicit reviewer-lane passes before quorum_submit. Keep agy-cli as fallback only, not a primary quorum host.
